title: Constrained Delegation (KCD) Abuse

references.name: MITRE ATT&CK - T1558 Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets

description: An account configured for Kerberos Constrained Delegation (KCD) can request service tickets on behalf of other users to specified services. When the "protocol transition" option (S4U2Self/S4U2Proxy) is enabled, a compromised delegation account can impersonate arbitrary users, including privileged ones, to the configured target services. Misconfigured service lists can expand the impact well beyond the intended scope.
businessImpact: Critical --- abuse allows impersonation of privileged users to sensitive services, enabling lateral movement, data access, and potential domain escalation.
remediation:
- Limit which accounts are trusted for constrained delegation and to which services.
- Avoid enabling protocol transition ("Use any authentication protocol") unless strictly required.
- Protect delegation accounts as highly privileged assets and add sensitive users to Protected Users.
- Audit msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo attributes and review delegation configuration regularly.
